title: Compute the sphere Hessian and its tangent quadratic form
source_anchor: Boumal, §5.5, Example 5.17, projected operator and its tangent quadratic form; printed p. 96 / PDF p. 112
target_statement: For any continuous real-linear A and unit x, the derivative of the stated extension, projected to the tangent plane, has the displayed operator and form on every tangent u. For symmetric A the extension represents the actual sphere gradient, so this is the Hessian of the half-Rayleigh objective.
